candidates.description: This vector represents Thai words indicating quantities, numbers, and distribution.
This feature vector activates strongly on Thai consonant-vowel clusters and syllable fragments, particularly those involving mid-class consonants combined with common vowels.
This vector activates strongly for the Thai consonant 'ม' (Mo Ma) across various tonal marks and contextual pairings.
This vector represents the Thai vowel sign Sara I combined with various consonants and tone marks.
This vector represents the concept of surfing and related wave sports.
This feature vector activates on mixed-script textual noise and fragmented subwords across multiple languages.
This vector activates strongly for Thai language script and characters.
This feature vector represents the concept of skateboarding, its equipment, and related terminology.
This feature vector activates on tokens containing or related to the word "paddle" across multiple languages and sub-word fragmentations.
This vector activates on diverse multilingual text fragments, including English words, Thai script, and sub-word tokens with no clear semantic unity.
